packageRules.description: The CLI's own dependencies. Safe to group — CI runs the unit tests.
Versions Xocket emits into generated projects. The scaffold matrix proves a bump is safe, so minor/patch can self-merge.
Majors always get a human. The generated stack changes shape across majors — Tailwind 3 to 4 removed the config file entirely.
ESLint 10 is ahead of the plugin ecosystem; eslint-plugin-react peers on ^9.7 and crashes on 10. Unpin this once that lands.

customManagers.description: Keep src/versions.ts in sync with npm. Every range there is emitted into generated projects, so it needs the same update treatment as a real manifest.
